# ECOS Medicare Solutions — Washington

> Free, plain-English Medicare guidance for Washington State retirees and people approaching 65. Compare Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement (Medigap) and Part D drug plans with a credentialed, independent agent at no cost. Statewide service by phone and video, from Seattle, Bellevue and Tacoma to Spokane, Yakima, Wenatchee, the Tri-Cities, Bellingham and Vancouver.

Contact: (702) 706-6564 · darinweidauer@ecos.care · https://www.ecosinsurancesolutions.com/washington

## About
ECOS Medicare Solutions is an independent Medicare insurance agency serving the State of Washington. Agent: Darin Weidauer, MBA, RSSA — gerontologist, Registered Social Security Analyst, 22-year U.S. Air Force veteran, licensed in Washington, NPN 18580338, WA License #1010707. Help is free to the consumer; independent agents are paid by carriers at enrollment, and the premium is the same whichever way you buy. Author page: https://www.myecos360.com/darin-weidauer

## What to know about Medicare in Washington
- Darin Weidauer holds Washington insurance license #1010707 (NPN 18580338).
- Washington uses the federal Medigap plan letters (A–N), regulated by the Washington State Office of the Insurance Commissioner. Washington law lets anyone who already has a Medigap policy switch to another Medigap plan at any time of year without medical underwriting; the one limit is that a Plan A holder can move only to another Plan A. The rule is for existing Medigap policyholders, not for a move from Medicare Advantage.
- Washington's SHIP is the Statewide Health Insurance Benefits Advisors (SHIBA) program, run by the Office of the Insurance Commissioner with volunteer counselors in local offices: 800-562-6900.
- Washington Medicaid is Apple Health, run by the Washington State Health Care Authority; eligibility for people 65 and over and for the Medicare Savings Programs runs through the Department of Social and Health Services. For 2026 the Medicare Savings Programs (QMB at 110% of the federal poverty level, SLMB at 120%, QI-1 at 138%) have income limits only, no resource test, and qualifying brings Part D Extra Help automatically.
- For 2026 UW Medicine has said it will not be contracted with Humana, PacificSource or Wellpoint (formerly Amerigroup) plans, and nationally UnitedHealthcare, Humana and Aetna each left about 100–200 counties. Which plans include UW Medicine, Providence Swedish, MultiCare, Virginia Mason Franciscan, Kaiser Permanente Washington or a rural hospital district is decided plan by plan and county by county.
- Washington has three VA medical-center systems: VA Puget Sound (Seattle and American Lake, serving more than 125,000 veterans in 14 counties), Mann-Grandstaff VA Medical Center in Spokane (more than 30,000 veterans a year), and the Jonathan M. Wainwright Memorial VA Medical Center in Walla Walla. Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Naval Base Kitsap and Fairchild Air Force Base anchor large TRICARE For Life retiree communities.
- Washington has 39 counties and a sharp east–west divide: Advantage menus and hospital choice are deepest in King, Pierce, Snohomish, Spokane and Clark counties, thinner in the rural counties east of the Cascades and along the coast, where a Medigap policy's any-provider access often decides the choice.

## Verified 2026 figures (CMS)
- Medicare Part B standard premium: $202.90/month; annual deductible: $283
- Part A hospital deductible: $1,736 per benefit period
- Part D out-of-pocket cap: $2,100/year; maximum deductible: $615; national base premium: $38.99
- IRMAA (income surcharge) begins above $109,000 (single) / $218,000 (joint), based on 2024 MAGI

## Compliance
We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov, 1-800-MEDICARE, or Washington’s Statewide Health Insurance Benefits Advisors (SHIBA, the State Health Insurance Assistance Program run by the Office of the Insurance Commissioner, 800-562-6900) to get information on all of your options. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government or the federal Medicare program. This is a solicitation for insurance.
